label: Subnautica sandboxes
description: How Subnautica sandboxes deploy, and how to find the game on this machine. Paths: mo2.

notes: BepInEx itself is not a mod and is not installed here; unpack the Subnautica BepInEx pack into the game folder once.
Older mods target QModManager and live in QMods. Current mods use BepInEx; the two should not be mixed in one install.
Saves are in the SNAppData/SavedGames folder inside the game directory.
Hard links are the default: nothing is copied twice when two sandboxes share a mod, and every file is still a real file to the game.
